headline: Associated Alcohols & Breweries launches new Tequila brand
hook: New product category for the brewer
summary: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Ltd has announced the launch of a new Tequila product, according to an exchange filing dated October 29, 2026. The move expands the company's alcoholic beverage portfolio into the growing tequila segment. Indian retail investors can monitor how this new product line contributes to the company's revenue diversification and margins.
whats_next: Quarterly earnings reflecting new product sales
why_it_matters: New product segment could diversify revenue for retail investors
